name: Tarea
title: Descendant of King Saul
summary: Tarea (also called Tahrea) was a descendant of King Saul through the line of Jonathan. He was the son of Mica and grandson of Mephibosheth (Merib-Baal), who himself was the son of Jonathan. Tarea is mentioned in the genealogies of Chronicles as part of Saul's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Saul's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Tarea is listed as one of the sons of Mica in the genealogy of King Saul, as part of the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the Genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Saul's lineage is repeated in 1 Chronicles chapter 9, where Tarea is again mentioned as a son of Mica (here called Tahrea).

keyEvents.title: Mephibosheth's Line Preserved
keyEvents.description: Through Mika and his sons, including Tarea, the lineage of Jonathan and Saul was carried forward despite the family's fall from power.

keyEvents.title: Saul's Complete Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Tarea is part of the full listing of Saul's descendants that spans several generations in the Books of Chronicles.
